posts.name: Rajagopalan Vaidyanathan
posts.cooked:
Hi,

I would like to post about the issues that I(and am sure a lot of others too) faced during the OPPE today (7pm).

  1. The VM was unresponsive and lagging so badly that I couldn’t really do anything for almost 1 hour. I complained to the proctor about it and others did too.As a result, there was a broadcast sent saying VM will restart in 5 minutes but it didn’t happen for another 15 minutes at least. I complained again along with others and eventually the VM was restarted. This easily took more than an hour of our precious time putting up with an unresponsive VM
  2. The VM was refreshed before the exam and I lost all my setup for Tmux. I didn’t have the instructions handy to configure it again. This made me to work on a single window and unable to refer back to the question until I save my work and do synchro eval. This is painful because it lacks continuity in doing synchro show because the previous page information couldn’t be revisited unless I do synchro show again. I’m not sure how many times I would have had to do and the questions were so lengthy that it didn’t help.
  3. In spite of losing close to an hour on the VM being unresponsive, we got only 15 minutes of additional time.
  4. The synchro eval had lot of issues too; in spite of passing all tests(public and private), it gave some error that I couldn’t resolve. Again wasted time rerunning the same question many times.
  5. Effective time on the exam would be less than an hour in total though it is a 2 hour exam.

I would like you to do something about it because I didn’t finish 4 of the 5 questions - I only submitted one question successfully and all the others failed because of some problem that I couldn’t resolve in time.

This is atrocious that having spent so much time preparing and dedicating time for practicing, I had to put up with issues that were not in my control and stand to reappear for it next week. I take this as an insult to the hard yards that I and others have put in.

The help provided within the questions became an obstacle and hindrance than helping because the question became too long and time consuming to get to the actual question.

I’m not sure what the idea is to not allow us to have multiple windows open and if you have valid reasons then why can’t you make tmux part of your configuration so that we don’t have to worry about setting it up every time you refresh. Or, at least if told this would be the case, I would have come prepared by noting down the configuration details.

With all the problems with the whole setup, the VM’s slow response, I feel frustrated that I could get through this exam in spite of preparing well!

You cannot be doing this to the students, especially those that have a lot of other commitments and have committed to do well in the exam.

Please do something about the whole setup because it sucks to know that no matter how much you do work, prepare and practice, one is left to write a post in utter disgust after preparing well.

Regards

posts.name: Rajagopalan Vaidyanathan
posts.cooked:
I forgot to add something important…

The actual questions—especially the one involving the Fibonacci sequence—were incredibly confusing. Please review how that question was presented/rendered. It was all over the place, and the formula itself was so poorly formatted that I genuinely couldn’t understand what was being asked. For example, n-1 followed by a slash—was that a typo, a rendering issue, or just bad formatting? It was impossible to decipher.

I would have expected someone to review how the questions appear on screen to ensure they’re actually comprehensible. If there was a technical issue with how the formula rendered, that should have been caught and fixed before the assessment went live.

Also, regarding the help on commands, their purpose and their usage: they weren’t helpful at all. In fact, they were incredibly frustrating. Every time I had to do a synchro show, I had to wade through those instructions just to get to the actual question. If you insist on including them (and not allowing multiple windows), please separate them from the question itself so they’re optional for those who need them—not mandatory for everyone.

It’s now 1:40am on Sunday following the OPPE, and I’m still trying to recover from the excruciating experience of this OPPE. I’m exhausted, frustrated, and deeply disappointed.

Please take this feedback seriously. The experience was painful and needs urgent improvement.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
A few clarifications:

  • There will be no change in the question’s format – if you want to skip the Motivation section, you can scroll the batcat output using your Arrow keys, or j and k vim keys. You can also use d to go down one page at a time, or G to go to the end of the page.
  • There are no rendering issues – the math is typeset using \LaTeX and you see the code for that. batcat does not render \LaTeX by itself, so it remains in the source-code format. Given you have done ma1001, ma1002, ma1003, and ma1004 courses in foundation level, and have been using Discourse from that time, it is expected of you to know to parse basic math typesetting in \LaTeX.
  • There should be less throttling in the VM in REOPPE, as we will configure the VMs with a higher resources like the last half.
  • Tmux is not set with custom configurations, that can be done by each student as per their liking, since there is no ‘one-good’ configuration. You are taught how to configure it, so that you can tweak it to your liking. You can also use unconfigured tmux, it does not hinder you from using it since navigating between panes and scrolling can still be done using the correct hotkeys. The VM will remain open from 6PM (1hr before questions are released), like the last time. Students are encouraged to login, and configure any configurations (bashrc, tmux.conf etc) that they require.
  • Login keys do not have to be re-generated, this has been clarified throughout the term, that once you have an ssh key, you never have to regenerate it, simply upload it wherever it is required.
  • You can use two terminals as well, instead of using tmux, I believe this was present in the portal.
  • There was an extension of 30 mins, not 15, for the server upgrade which only took 5 mins of downtime, rest was given as a concession, since students would also need time to re-login, and re-type any unsaved code in their editor.
  • If you have got \ge40, you cannot re-attempt the OPPE.

posts.name: Rajagopalan Vaidyanathan
posts.cooked:
Hi @sayan ,

Yesterday, I was connected to support after waiting restlessly for 23 minutes. During that time, the Proctor informed me that the issue had been escalated. Unfortunately, the time I lost waiting was precious — I’m confident I could have solved another problem had I been assisted promptly.

I understand that logging into the wrong VM was considered my mistake, but the refusal to grant additional time felt unfair. Why was the BPT VM even present during the exam when it wasn’t available during our preparation? It caused confusion and cost me valuable time. I was one of the earlier ones to join google meet well ahead of the exam to make sure I do everything I had to and not face an issue like last time - with Tmux, etc.

Your decision to deny my request for extra time effectively cost me marks! Was it truly my fault that I had to wait 23 minutes to be connected to support? I repeatedly asked the Proctor for help, only to be told to remain quiet because the issue was already escalated. I even requested a few extra minutes to finish the question I was working on — I was close to completing it.

The support for this course has been mediocre, to say the least. I asked for the portal link mentioned in your post about using two terminal sessions, but received no response. Despite repeated requests to correct grading errors, nothing has been done. You stated that the motivational section at the top of the question would remain unchanged, yet it was altered — and not even acknowledged. If it was a good idea, why not say so?

You also mentioned a session I should have attended to know which VM to use. But with so many sessions and unclear communication, it’s difficult to know what’s essential and what’s not. The volume of communication itself becomes a source of confusion.

I will certainly pass this time — I’ve correctly solved three questions. But the 23 minutes I lost could have helped me reach a perfect score. For you, this may be just a job. For students, it’s their career. And for me, it’s even more than that — I’m at the tail end of my career, striving to achieve something I couldn’t during my school and college days. During the first OPPE, it was a VM issue with no proper compensation. This time, it was the wrong VM.

Please, going forward, take a closer look at the challenges students face. Don’t shift the blame onto us. Improvement begins with acknowledging that there are issues — and then working to fix them.

Kind regards,
Rajagopalan Vaidyanathan

Hi @sayan ,

Yesterday, I was connected to support after waiting restlessly for 23 minutes. During that time, the Proctor informed me that the issue had been escalated. Unfortunately, the time I lost waiting was precious — I’m confident I could have solved another problem had I been assisted promptly.

I understand that logging into the wrong VM was considered my mistake, but the refusal to grant additional time felt unfair. Why was the BPT VM even present during the exam when it wasn’t available during our preparation? It caused confusion and cost me valuable time. I was one of the earlier ones to join google meet well ahead of the exam to make sure I do everything I had to and not face an issue like last time - with Tmux, etc.

Your decision to deny my request for extra time effectively cost me marks! Was it truly my fault that I had to wait 23 minutes to be connected to support? I repeatedly asked the Proctor for help, only to be told to remain quiet because the issue was already escalated. I even requested a few extra minutes to finish the question I was working on — I was close to completing it.

The support for this course has been mediocre, to say the least. I asked for the portal link mentioned in your post about using two terminal sessions, but received no response. Despite repeated requests to correct grading errors, nothing has been done. You stated that the motivational section at the top of the question would remain unchanged, yet it was altered — and not even acknowledged. If it was a good idea, why not say so?

You also mentioned a session I should have attended to know which VM to use. But with so many sessions and unclear communication, it’s difficult to know what’s essential and what’s not. The volume of communication itself becomes a source of confusion.

I will certainly pass this time — I’ve correctly solved three questions. But the 23 minutes I lost could have helped me reach a perfect score. For you, this may be just a job. For students, it’s their career. And for me, it’s even more than that — I’m at the tail end of my career, striving to achieve something I couldn’t during my school and college days. During the first OPPE, it was a VM issue with no proper compensation. This time, it was the wrong VM.

Please, going forward, take a closer look at the challenges students face. Don’t shift the blame onto us. Improvement begins with acknowledging that there are issues — and then working to fix them.

Kind regards,
Rajagopalan Vaidyanathan

@22f2000345

The support meets are for technical issues faced by the students, not for student-side issues. Just like you there are many students in line for the meet, we cannot possibly admit all at once and be able to address anyone. However, since your issue was a student-side negligence, not any technical issue, it does not warrant any additional time. The NPPE, the 16th Aug OPPE, and this OPPE, all has been conducted on OPPE VM. Further in the Exam Portal Question 2 it has also been clearly mentioned which VM to use, the website for re-uploading the ssh key (if required), and the exact domain of the VM. If a student is not able to follow the instructions given in the exam portal itself, it is not possible to grant an additional time, it would be unfair for the other students who have worked hard to earn their marks.

Using two terminals being allowed is mentioned in the exam portal question itself, as I mentioned earlier. There is no link for such, it is present in the exam portal.
